_comment: Self-test B — SCOPED mode (PD-032). C2B06a-CW1 stands for another block-half's already-validated worksheet and carries audit_scope=pt_overlap_only. It is deliberately loaded with three faults that would FAIL if it were graded here: a run of 3 identical answers (de-patterning), a stated_total that does not match its items (mark totals), and a duplicated item text (within-sheet duplicates). Expected: those three gates PASS (scoped sheet skipped), while PT zero-overlap STILL FAILS on the planted duplicate — proving the sheet is visible to that gate and only that gate.
